scope: Original English 2023 Dune: Imperium — Uprising v23-10-12; standard 2–4-player multiplayer including one ordinary scoring Rival for two humans; optional base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts. Identify but exclude 10 Rise of Ix contracts; exclude all optional Rival variants, solo, six-player teams, expansions and later products. Apply relevant general/Uprising Jan 13 2025 FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Standard multiplayer and optional 20-contract CHOAM scope is explicit; the separate 10 Rise of Ix compatibility contracts and Streamlined-only Rivals are excluded. Shared and personal component counts and starting deck agree with the rulebook.

checked_claims.topic: Setup: board, Leaders, shared cards, Objectives and private supplies
checked_claims.detail: Checked every setup location and starting amount, conflict tier counts/randomization/concealment, CHOAM card omission, deck faces, eligible Objective filtering/face-up placement/first player, 4-player starting VP, Agents/Swordmaster, troops, water and bank.

Conflict reveal and defensive troop precede hand draw; turns alternate with one Reveal; Rival uses its remaining Agents and never Reveals. Entry costs/requirements precede destination and Agent-card effects; permitted Plot Intrigue timing supports acquiring resources before entry.

checked_claims.topic: Agent access, effects, Spy access and occupancy
checked_claims.detail: One played card and Agent, matching access icon or Spy Agent access, unoccupied destination except another player via Infiltrate, entry requirements and costs, one Faction advance and free effect ordering all agree. Normal access is still required when infiltrating.

checked_claims.topic: Reveal, strength, acquiring, discard and trash
checked_claims.detail: Checked ordered Reveal steps, any-order effects and purchase interleaving, updated strength, troop/sandworm/sword values and zero-unit rule, +20 marker, reserve/row purchases and immediate refill, card destinations and reshuffle, optional trash exceptions, discard hand origin and recall/retreat destinations.

Troops originate in supply, enter garrison unless deployed; Combat visit permits all newly recruited this turn plus two old garrison units. Sandworms deploy immediately from bank and never enter a garrison. Hooks are conditional prerequisites and retained; Shield Wall remains an independent restriction.

checked_claims.topic: Conflict, priority, rewards, ties, battle icons and cleanup
checked_claims.detail: Checked eligibility and consecutive-pass loop, marker adjustment when Intrigue resolves, player-count reward limits, all first/second/third tie branches, zero-strength exclusion, ordered won-card face-up placement then mandatory match, sandworm doubling limits/cost repeat, troop/sandworm destinations and reset.

Checked Agent-free spice accrual at three Maker spaces, end-of-round threshold/deck exhaustion, Agent recall and first-player transfer, Endgame Intrigue then scores, wild match, four ordinary tiebreakers and final most-recent-Reveal tiebreaker; retain acquired Spice Must Flow VP and permit scores over 12.

checked_claims.topic: Influence, Alliances, control and Shield Wall
checked_claims.detail: 2-Influence VP and reversibility; separate repeatable/retained 4-Influence track reward and token VP; challenge transfers and loss-trigger transfers/return; no transfer just from challenger tie; required Influence access; controller receives bonus on any visitor and defensive troop comes from supply; Wall removal optional and permanent.

checked_claims.topic: Spies, Intrigue and miscellaneous card/Leader clarifications
checked_claims.detail: Checked optional placement and recall, legal posts/origin/destination, no-supply recall, Spy Agent no-recall access, immediate Gather Intelligence decision, two distinct Spy effects, Intrigue hidden hand/type timing/costs/discard/reshuffle and theft threshold, Fremen Bond/in-play/acquire, printed Leader clarifications and relevant Uprising FAQ entries.

checked_claims.topic: CHOAM: setup, taking and completing standard contracts
source_references: original Shaddam image: Sardaukar Commander left ability
checked_claims.detail: 20 standard contracts remain distinct from 10 Ix contracts. Original Shaddam print explicitly sets aside both Sardaukar contracts and restricts acquisition to him; FAQ establishes substitution and no initial possession. Summary correctly derives 18 shuffled/2 offered/16 bank with Shaddam, versus 20/2/18 without; validates extra decks, fallback 2 Solari, replacement, all completion categories, must-have-held-at-placement, mandatory completion, multiple same-space contracts, timing and completed-token destination.

checked_claims.topic: Required Rival setup and turn procedure
checked_claims.detail: One standard scoring Rival; setup supplies/objective/first-player seating, Hagal reshuffle, never Reveal, occupied retry, conditional destination selection without fallback, Place Spy continuation, ignore normal board costs/effects, printed gains/priority/Influence bonuses, troops and mandatory deployment agree.

source_references: supplements PDF p5 resource diagram, visually inspected
checked_claims.detail: Checked Faction priority and specified posts, no legal post behavior, third-Spy immediate recall of other two and Scheme, same-turn Scheme troop deployment, mixed Swordmaster threshold and spend priority, immediate Agent and leftovers, separate 7 Solari/7 spice/3 Intrigue/3 water VP conversions, retained Influence VP/Alliance but no track resource bonus, Hooks and conditional Wall removal, Maker bonus/base spice and worm choice.

checked_claims.topic: Rival Combat, control, Influence, optional VP and contracts
checked_claims.detail: Checked beginning-of-Combat Hagal swords in turn order before human Intrigues, reshuffle, ordinary and doubled rewards, card/battle-icon scoring, control/defensive bonus, least-Influence then priority tie-break, pay optional VP when possible, and 2 Solari instead of contracts even with CHOAM.

read_completeness.method: Each reading range was returned by its own separate functions.exec invocation and its own shell tool call. No multi-chunk combined outputs. No reading output was truncated. Exact splitlines counts include any final unterminated line, and all final ranges reached the counted file ends.

visual_evidence.description: Unannotated original printed Shaddam Leader image, directly viewed; read both abilities, especially set-aside/exclusive acquisition text.
Unannotated publisher supplement PDF p5 render directly viewed; read missing icon-only Rival conversion rows: 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigue cards, 3 water each to 1 VP.

read_completeness.pdf_assets: All three supplied publisher PDFs hashed and page counts checked (20/14/4). Complete authorized extracted texts were read; the supplied p5 render resolves icon-only resource conversion evidence. No additional PDF renders were necessary.

independence_statement: Fresh independent source audit of only the exact frozen expanded-iteration-12 summary. I read the complete authorized three text sources separately and inspected the unannotated original Shaddam image and resource diagram myself. I did not read other summary versions, audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers/grades, or other provenance/conclusion files, and did not communicate with readers. No summary edits were made. PASS is based on the checks recorded here, not any prior verdict.
limitations: Printed card-specific text is deferred to the actual components where the supplied sources do so; no unsupported card details were invented. Pending/historical verification front matter is publication status, not a rules claim.
